description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - Notify the First Meeting of the Poojapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha in Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically concerns the nomination process for Chairman and Vice Chairman positions in a Local Government Institution (Poojapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha) as per the Amended Local Government Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the date, time, and location for the first meeting to conduct these nominations, which falls under electoral processes and related administrative matters for local government. This content is directly related to elections and local government electoral procedures, making it a Type 7 (Elections) classification.
